title: Owens summons lightning near the Camden Bridge

tellings.quote: Owens pointed his finger at the bridge and according to the affidavit, lightning struck within a few moments, not hitting the bridge, but in that general vicinity.

plain: In the 1960s in Philadelphia, Ted Owens, a man who claimed psychic powers, pointed his finger at the Camden Bridge, and within moments lightning struck nearby, not on the bridge but close to it. Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of psychic abilities, relays this from a sworn statement by a witness named Sydney Margolies, and also cites the books How to Contact Space People and The PK Man. If true, it would mean Owens could call up weather with his mind.
